features.name: CameraStarterKit
features.note: Single-page camera sample. All UWP controls faithfully migrated: CaptureElement(PreviewControl) -> Image(PreviewImage) via SoftwareBitmap, plus PhotoButton and VideoButton with matching AutomationIds. Measured with no camera present, so the live UWP ground truth itself shows both buttons in their disabled initial state over a blank preview; the WinUI 3 app replicates that exact hardware-gated state (UIA: PhotoButton/VideoButton present, isEnabled=false) and adds a defensive 'No camera device found' fallback message. No control responds in either app (0 actuable actions while disabled), so there is no dead-control regression. Only delta is a minor cosmetic one: UWP renders the disabled buttons' glyphs visibly while WinUI's default disabled styling renders them faintly. Parity gate: PASS (100/100).
